notes: Adds one missing Mass: Notre-Dame-des-Victoires, Midlands - Saturday 17:30, third Saturday of the month only, a chapel of the Sainte-Therese-d'Avila parish (Hautes Plaines Wilhems). Found while reviewing the Assomption feast crosswalk: the chapel has its own diocese page (https://dioceseportlouis.org/paroisses-messes/notre-dame-des-victoires-midlands/) publishing that time, but had no row in the corpus. This is a new site, taking the corpus to 414 rows / 117 sites. Coordinates are deliberately left empty: the diocese publishes none, and reusing the parish coordinate (Curepipe) would misplace the chapel in Near-me, since Midlands is a separate locality - Directions fall back to a maps_query text search until a coordinate is sourced. Also checked in the same pass: 8 other churches named in the Assomption PDF but absent from the corpus. Six have a diocese page that publishes no Mass times at all (four say 'Pas de messes' outright), and two - Saint Victor and Fraternite Franciscaine - have no diocese page. None of them needed a row.
